title: Kotlin coroutines trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for coroutine trace events: the dispatchers and their worker threads, the coroutines and the Job tree they live in, the state machine the compiler generated for a suspend fun, what the run cost, and the scale comparison.

dispatchers.description: The CoroutineDispatchers: Default (sized to cores), IO (sized for blocking calls) and Main.

threads.description: The real worker threads this dispatcher owns.

coroutine.description: The coroutine currently borrowing this thread, or null when it is idle.

blocked.description: True when a non-suspending call is holding the thread inside the OS.

queue.description: Coroutines that are ready to run but have no free thread yet.

coroutines.description: Every coroutine started in this run, in creation order.

name.description: The name the example gave it.

scope.description: The scope whose Job is its parent.

kind.description: LAUNCH returns a Job; ASYNC returns a Deferred that carries a result.

state.description: SUSPENDED means alive on the heap and holding no thread at all.

thread.description: The worker it is executing on, or null whenever it is not executing.

doing.description: The suspension point, blocking call or computation it is at.

cancelRequested.description: cancel() has set isActive to false, which by itself stops nothing.

awaiting.description: The Deferred it is suspended in await() on.

scopes.description: The Job tree: which scope owns which coroutines.

kind.description: SUPERVISOR does not let a child's failure reach its siblings; GLOBAL has no parent.

state.description: A scope completes only after every child has.

children.description: Coroutines whose parent Job this is.

machine.description: Only on the compiler events: the state machine a suspend fun was rewritten into.

function.description: The suspend fun as it was written.

label.description: The when(label) branch being executed; -1 before the function has ever run.

cases.description: The branches of the generated when(label), one per suspension point plus the tail.

code.description: A sketch of the generated body of that branch.

current.description: True for the branch being executed now.

saved.description: The fields of the continuation object: locals and results that must survive a suspension.

suspended.description: True while invokeSuspend has returned COROUTINE_SUSPENDED and no thread holds this work.

returned.description: The value the function finally returned, once it has.

stats.description: Running totals for the whole run.

alive.description: Coroutines not yet completed, cancelled or failed.

peakAlive.description: The most that existed at once — compare it with `threads`.

threads.description: Real worker threads across all dispatchers.

resumes.description: Times a continuation was resumed with a value.

dispatches.description: Times a thread picked a continuation up.

queued.description: Times a ready coroutine had to wait for a thread.

blockingCalls.description: Non-suspending calls that held a worker thread.

leaked.description: GlobalScope coroutines left running with no owner.

scale.description: Only on SCALE_COMPARED: the same number of concurrent tasks priced three ways.

model.description: How the concurrent tasks are represented.

memoryMb.description: Stacks reserved, or continuation objects allocated.

osThreads.description: Threads the OS scheduler has to know about.

keyword.description: Whether the model colours functions: coroutines need `suspend`, threads do not.

feasible.description: Whether a normal JVM can actually run that many.
